node.label: Reduced 3-phosphoglycerate dehydrogenase activity
node.definition: Diminished activity of the enzyme 3-phosphoglycerate dehydrogenase (PGDH), which catalyzes the first step in the pathway by converting D-3-phosphoglycerate (PGA), an intermediate in glycolysis, to phosphohydroxypyruvate concomitant with the reduction of NAD+.

evidence.snippet: Phosphoglycerate dehydrogenase deficiency: Reduced 3-phosphoglycerate dehydrogenase activity [TAS]
